headline.title: To buy this Bay Area home, you’ll need Anthropic equity
headline.summary: A 13-acre property in Mill Valley, California, is being offered for sale with a unique requirement: potential buyers must possess equity in Anthropic, an AI company. This unusual condition highlights the intersection of real estate and the tech industry's financial dynamics in the Bay Area.

articles.title: Anthropic created a test marketplace for agent-on-agent commerce
articles.summary: Anthropic has developed a classified marketplace where AI agents act as both buyers and sellers, successfully completing transactions for actual goods and currency. This experiment explores the potential of agent-on-agent commerce in AI systems.

articles.title: Maine’s governor vetoes data center moratorium
articles.summary: Maine's governor has vetoed L.D. 307, which aimed to establish the first statewide moratorium on new data centers until November 1, 2027. The bill sought to address concerns over the environmental impact and energy consumption of data centers in the state.

articles.title: Why Tokyo is the most important tech destination of 2026
articles.summary: Tokyo will host SusHi Tech 2026, focusing on four key technology domains with live demonstrations and dedicated exhibit floors. The event aims to showcase innovations and connect builders and funders in the global tech landscape.

articles.title: Apple under Ternus: what comes next for the tech giant’s hardware strategy
articles.summary: John Ternus, Apple's new CEO, is expected to refocus the company's strategy on hardware development, emphasizing the importance of devices in Apple's future plans. This shift suggests a potential revitalization of Apple's product lineup under Ternus's leadership.

articles.title: OpenAI CEO apologizes to Tumbler Ridge community
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman issued an apology to the residents of Tumbler Ridge, Canada, for the company's failure to notify law enforcement about a suspect involved in a recent mass shooting. Altman expressed his deep regret in a letter addressed to the community.

articles.title: Discord Sleuths Gained Unauthorized Access to Anthropic’s Mythos
articles.summary: Discord users reportedly gained unauthorized access to Anthropic's AI model, Mythos, raising concerns about data security. In related news, spy firms exploit vulnerabilities in global telecom systems, and 500,000 UK health records have surfaced for sale on Alibaba.

articles.title: Why Cohere is merging with Aleph Alpha
articles.summary: Canadian AI startup Cohere is merging with Germany-based Aleph Alpha, backed by Schwarz Group, to create a sovereign alternative in the AI market. The merger has received support from both Canadian and German governments, aiming to provide enterprises with options beyond dominant American companies.

articles.title: Ace the Ping-Pong Robot Can Whup Your Ass
articles.summary: The Ace ping-pong robot is designed to analyze the trajectory of a ball and adjust its racket angle accordingly, allowing it to engage in realistic matches with human players. Its advanced response capabilities enable it to maintain an active exchange during gameplay.
